Apparently (and shockinly) our environment (google cloud) doesn't allow us to connect to ipv6 addresses, but my host pool contains a whole bunch of them and this stalls the node as it's essentially going from peer to peer getting and failing to resolve them. Anything I can do here? Can I configure something to force only ipv4 addresses to be added to the host pool?
